reviews.text:
Assembly is easy and no pieces were missing. Shipping was quick!

Overall the quality is decent. Being plastic that is sewing together, it can tear easily, which happened when I tried to pull the green cord too tight when fastening it to the green tubing. As a green house and storage area, it works great!

Be aware that this structure, or any structure like it, is NOT suitable for areas with high wind. Unfortunately, before we could reinforce it properly in some way, we were hit with 50 - 60kpm wind gusts and the the plastic almost flew off.  The wind tore some holes in the seams and knocked over some seeds on the shelving. This isn't the fault of the product, because it's pretty for the price! Just be sure to understand its limitations and don't expect it to be as solid as something with steel tubing where the plastic is secured with clips.

reviews.text:
I’m writing this review after receiving the item and seeing it in person. So far, I haven’t used it for a long time. I plan to use it for about a month and then I can give a more detailed update.

Overall, I really like it. The design is cute and it looks like the pictures. However, the seat space is smaller than I expected. The photos make it seem like two babies can sit and play together, but in reality only one baby can use it at a time. If you’re buying this for two children to sit together, it won’t work. For one child, it’s perfectly fine.

Right now, I can’t say much about how long the battery lasts since we haven’t used it enough yet. The plastic quality looks okay at first impression, but I’ll need more time to see how durable it really is.
